notes: CoindeskToken (src/CoindeskToken.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC20 named Coindesk with symbol COINDESK and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 COINDESK (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on the launch is the ProjectFactory. There is no mint function, no minter role, no owner, no pause, no blacklist, no freeze, no transfer tax, no burn hook, no proxy and no delegatecall: every transfer moves exactly what it says, so the swarm's share, the pool seed and the remainder arrive whole. No application contracts are deployed with this launch. The pool pairs with IMD; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
